valores.label: houses destroyed or removed, total to June 30, 1915

fonte: The Panama Canal, Annual Report of the Governor, FY 1915
legenda: Houses, not people: the report does not count residents removed.
nota: Relido no relatório de 1915 (p. 432 pelo dossiê): "1,136 privately owned houses were destroyed by the police, or removed by the owners..." e "Since the beginning of this work a total of 3,988 houses have been destroyed or removed". A voz diz "almost four thousand privately owned houses": o "privately owned" está na frase das 1.136 e o total segue o mesmo trabalho; nuance, não divergência de número. Ordem de despovoamento de 05/12/1912; limpeza desde 01/01/1913. Relatório de 1915: "The President's depopulation order of December 5, 1912" (midia/zona-do-canal/fontes/documento/annualreportofgo1915cana.txt); relatório da Isthmian Canal Commission de 1914: "which clearing was started on January 1, 1913" (midia/zona-do-canal/fontes/evento/annualreportofis1914isth_djvu.txt; archive.org, item annualreportofis1914isth). Parte pode ser da área do lago Gatún.
status_conferencia: conferido_primario (cópia local da fonte primária, relida nesta tarefa)
